env.build: main at 7a04adf + the uncommitted rev 6 phase-2 working tree (bun run dev) for runs B and C; run A started on d84cfde and another session committed feac2d3…7a04adf while it ran
env.note: Starts on the title screen of a fresh userData. Model timing varies, so every wait on the model is a polling eval, never a fixed sleep. window.__e2e collects the timestamps; the last evals print them. Shots b-*.jpg are run C: this list replayed end to end in one call. Run B was the same list split at the quote for a prompt-size probe; run A (shots 00-17) drove the same steps one call at a time, plus a redraw and a second Build in the cancelled draft. The no-key variant is run-nokey.json (it needs its own launch).

model: openai · gpt-5.4-mini (System → Model default on a fresh userData: Cloud API, key from .env). Pictures: gpt-image-1-mini (ImageProvider default, quality low, concept 1024² resized to 512²).

actions.eval: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<200;i++){const p=document.querySelector('[data-stream-preview=world]'); if(p&&p.innerText.length>40){p.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});return {atMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.rw0,text:p.innerText.slice(0,200)};} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));} return 'no stream preview';})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<480;i++){if(!document.querySelector('[data-stream-preview]') && ![...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='取消')) return {rewriteMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.rw0}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return 'still running';})()

({drawing: document.body.innerText.match(/正在畫 \d 張草圖[^\n]*/)?.[0] ?? null, storyHeader: document.body.innerText.match(/正在撰寫故事[^\n]*/)?.[0] ?? null, story: document.querySelector('[data-stream-preview=story]')?.innerText.slice(0,200) ?? null})

(async()=>{const seen={}; let storyDone=null; for(let i=0;i<720;i++){const n=document.querySelectorAll('[data-look-pictures] img').length; if(!(n in seen)) seen[n]=Date.now()-window.__e2e.look0; if(storyDone===null && !/正在撰寫故事/.test(document.body.innerText)) storyDone=Date.now()-window.__e2e.look0; if(n>=3) return {picturesAtMs:seen, storyPanelGoneAtMs:storyDone}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return {seen, body: document.body.innerText.slice(0,400)};})()

(async()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-look-pictures] button')].find(x=>x.innerText.includes('已選的樣子')); const src=b.querySelector('img').src; const bin=atob(src.slice(src.indexOf(',')+1)); const u=new Uint8Array(bin.length); for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i); const h=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',u); window.__e2e.chosenSha=[...new Uint8Array(h)].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join(''); return {labels:[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-look-pictures] button')].map(x=>x.innerText.trim()), bytes:u.byteLength, sha256:window.__e2e.chosenSha};})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<480;i++){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==='前往建立'); if(b&&!b.disabled) return {storyWaitMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.story0, chapters:[...document.body.innerText.matchAll(/第 (\d) 章/g)].length}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return document.body.innerText.slice(0,400);})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<80;i++){const q=document.querySelector('[data-quote]'); if(q&&q.innerText.includes('這份草稿')) return q.innerText; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return document.querySelector('[data-quote]')?.innerText ?? 'no quote';})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<960;i++){const t=document.body.innerText; if(/因果/.test(t)&&/背包/.test(t)&&!t.includes('建立遊戲')){window.__e2e.playAt=Date.now(); return {buildMs:window.__e2e.playAt-window.__e2e.build0, wordsToLandMs:window.__e2e.playAt-window.__e2e.t0};} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return document.body.innerText.slice(0,600);})()
({writingAhead: document.body.innerText.match(/正在撰寫下一章[^\n]*/)?.[0] ?? null, usage: document.body.innerText.match(/本世界[^\n]*/)?.[0] ?? null})
